description: This file defines the DeviceResources class responsible for managing DirectX device, swap chain, and rendering resources for a Windows application using DirectX and XAML interop. It includes setup for device creation, window size adjustments, device validation, and presentation logic, with specific focus on handling high-resolution displays and device loss scenarios.

classes.name: DeviceResources
classes.description: Manages DirectX device, swap chain, and rendering resources, handles window size changes, device validation, and presentation.

methods.name: CreateDeviceIndependentResources
methods.description: Initializes Direct2D, DirectWrite, and WIC factories.

methods.name: CreateDeviceResources
methods.description: Creates the Direct3D device, context, and associated Direct2D device and context.

methods.name: CreateWindowSizeDependentResources
methods.description: Creates or resizes swap chain, render target, depth stencil, and related resources based on window size.

methods.name: SetSwapChainPanel
methods.description: Associates a SwapChainPanel with the device resources and initializes rendering targets.

methods.name: SetLogicalSize
methods.description: Updates logical size and recreates size-dependent resources.

methods.name: SetDpi
methods.description: Updates DPI and recreates size-dependent resources.

methods.name: SetCurrentOrientation
methods.description: Updates display orientation and recreates size-dependent resources.

methods.name: SetCompositionScale
methods.description: Updates composition scale and recreates size-dependent resources.

methods.name: ValidateDevice
methods.description: Checks if the device is still valid; recreates device and resources if needed.

methods.name: HandleDeviceLost
methods.description: Recreates device and related resources after device loss.

methods.name: RegisterDeviceNotify
methods.description: Registers a notification interface for device loss events.

methods.name: Trim
methods.description: Informs the driver that the app is idle, allowing resource reclamation.

methods.name: Present
methods.description: Presents the swap chain content to the screen, handles device removal scenarios.
